<thought>Based on the ESI mass spectrum, the base peak at m/z 233.9632 corresponds to the monoisotopic molecular ion. The isotopic pattern (significant M+2 peak ~24 % of the base) indicates the presence of one chlorine atom. Subtracting the monoisotopic mass of 35Cl (34.968852 Da) leaves 198.9943 Da to be accounted for by C, H, and O. The combination C₇H₃O₇ matches this residual mass within ~0.006 Da, giving a total monoisotopic mass of 233.9567 Da, which is the closest plausible formula consistent with the observed isotopic pattern. Therefore the molecular formula is C₇H₃O₇Cl.</thought>
<final_answer>C7H3O7Cl</final_answer>
